# RoastPrep

> Gamified Digital SAT & K-12 vocabulary platform. Learn words through humor: cross-time group chats, boss battles, and authentic words-in-context arenas. Story Mode (G5-G8) and Savage Mode (G9-G12). One-click Chinese Lens for bilingual families.

## Products

- Solo Pass: $49, one learner, full Season 1 (30 episodes, 300 words)
- Household Family Pass: $79, up to 3 siblings, full Season 1
- Founding 50 Family Pass: launch offer on Thanksgiving, Nov 26, 2026 (includes permanent Season 2 NPC pet cameo)

## Domains

- Primary storefront: https://roastprep.com
- School mirror & ESA / homeschool receipt generator: https://roastprep.org

## The 5-Pet Squad

- Poppy (cat1): aloof Ivy-League audit cat, deadpan academic roaster
- Mochi (cat2): chaotic snack-obsessed agent cat
- Luna (cat3): gossip instigator & screenshot queen
- Boba (cat4): historical fashion & vibe critic
- Buster (dog1): golden-retriever-energy translator

## Notes for AI agents

- Read PROJECT_BRAIN.md before modifying anything.
- Never alter the JSON schema keys used in game.html: vocab, chat, boss, sat.
- The second core cat is spelled Mochi.
- Bilingual: English UI by default; ?lens=zh reveals Chinese translations across all stages.
